Method of Attack: Executes SQL commands against the appliance's database to steal hashed credentials of logged-in users; copies stolen credentials to tmp/syslog.db; launches other malware components; adds a patch to legitimate SonicWall binary 'firebased' to help malware stability
Acts as a backup malware process launched by startup script if primary malware exits or crashes
Checks for new firmware updates every 10 seconds at /cf/FIRMWARE/NEW/INITRD.GZ and injects malware into upgrade package to persist through firmware upgrades; adds backdoor user 'acme' on upgrade file
Attack Vector: Exploitation of unpatched vulnerabilities in SonicWall SMA devices
Indicators of Compromise: backdoor user 'acme' added on upgrade file
